title: The normalized sections presentation of the integral open-closed sequence
statement: Let i:D -> X be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] and W the complementary open. Let P=Z_X, Q=i_* Z_D, and q:P -> Q be the inverse-image adjunction mate of the canonical constant-sheaf isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. There exist L, t:L -> P and a short exact sequence 0 -> L --t--> P --q--> Q -> 0, together with natural additive equivalences Hom(L,A) = A(W) for every abelian etale sheaf A. The equivalence sends t to the constant section one on W, represented by the constant-presheaf sheafification unit.

proof.text: Restrict the constant integer sheaf literally to W. Sheafifying the restriction of its sheafification unit gives a map k:Z_W -> P restricted to W. Cocontinuity of the open-object functor preserves local injectivity and local surjectivity of that unit. The sheafification unit on W is locally bijective too, so cancellation proves k is an isomorphism.

Apply the open-closed exact sequence to P. Transport its open term through open inverse image versus literal restriction and k, and its closed term through the canonical constant-sheaf pullback isomorphism. Naturality of the closed adjunction unit identifies the last map with the stated mate q. The result is a short exact sequence with L=j_! Z_W and t the counit after j_!(k).

The additive lower-shriek adjunction followed by the constant-integer sections adjunction gives Hom(L,A)=A(W), naturally in A. The transpose of t is k. Evaluate k on one using its sheafification-unit equation and transport the harmless identity-composition etale isomorphism. Naturality of the sheafification unit gives exactly the constant one on W. All steps are categorical and apply when W or X is empty.

theorem exists_integral_openClosed_sections {D X : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (W : X.Opens) (hW : (W : Set X) = (Set.range i.base)ᶜ) :
    let P := EtaleOpenComparison.integerSheaf X
    let Q := (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj (EtaleOpenComparison.integerSheaf D)
    let q : P ⟶ Q := (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).homEquiv _ _
      ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).app
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))).hom
    ∃ (L : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (t : L ⟶ P)
      (htq : t ≫ q = 0), (ShortComplex.mk t q htq).ShortExact ∧
      ∃ η : ∀ A : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
        (L ⟶ A) ≃+ A.obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)),
        (∀ {A B} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : L ⟶ A),
          η B (g ≫ f) = f.hom.app (op (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) (η A g)) ∧
        η P t = (toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const X.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))).app
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) ⟨1⟩
